name: research
description: Fan-out: parallel research tracks that fan into one synthesis.

stages.name: frame
stages.task:
Turn this research objective into 3 distinct, non-overlapping sub-questions (state-of-the-art, tradeoffs/alternatives, and practical adoption/cost). Output them as a short list.

{task}

stages.name: track_a
stages.task:
Research sub-question #1 (state-of-the-art). Gather sources, summarize findings with confidence levels, and cite every claim.
{stage.frame}

stages.name: track_b
stages.task:
Research sub-question #2 (tradeoffs and alternatives). Gather sources, compare options, cite every claim.
{stage.frame}

stages.name: track_c
stages.task:
Research sub-question #3 (practical adoption, cost, and risks). Gather sources, cite every claim.
{stage.frame}

stages.name: synthesize
stages.task:
Synthesize the three research tracks into one coherent brief with a clear recommendation and a sources list. Flag disagreements between tracks.
{deps}
